notes.title: HOTFIX June 21st is LIVE!
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where the player would sometimes climb up enemies with the yellow power
Fixed an issue with the main menu where some elements got occluded in some screen resolutions
Fixed a broken link on the Twitter button in Main Menu
Reworked the way the super mode works! The orange bar will no longer decay and you can now press a button to control when you want to enter super mode.

notes.title: COMBAT DEMO IS OUT!
notes.content:
Yep, you read it right!

Colorful’s combat demo is now available on Steam! 
Click here or below to play the demo now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2277380

This byte-sized demo focuses on combat. This is still early in development so I'll use your feedback to then create a better demo that showcases more of the gameplay loop!

Give your feedback!
Don't hesitate to send your feedback! Share your impressions, gameplay insights, awful bugs, and any other suggestions! You can send your feedback HERE.

Thank you for being part of this journey!

~xinoHITO 🖌
